descriptions.Araneae: a spider or other arachnid with a compact body divided into two main segments, eight legs, and no wings
descriptions.Coleoptera: a beetle with a compact oval or elongated body and hard forewings forming protective elytra
descriptions.Diptera: a fly or related true fly with a compact body and one visible pair of functional wings, while the hind wings are reduced
descriptions.Hemiptera: a true bug with a segmented body and a distinctive piercing-sucking beak
descriptions.Hymenoptera: a bee, wasp, or ant with a segmented body, elbowed antennae, and membranous wings when present
descriptions.Lepidoptera: a butterfly or moth with broad wings covered in fine scales and a slender body
descriptions.Odonata: a dragonfly or damselfly with a long abdomen, large eyes, and two pairs of transparent wings
descriptions.aeroplane: a fixed-wing aircraft with a fuselage, wings, cockpit, and tail surfaces
descriptions.bicycle: a two-wheeled human-powered vehicle with a frame, two wheels, pedals, and handlebars
descriptions.bird: a feathered animal with a beak, wings, and a compact body; a partial view may show only the head, body, or wings
descriptions.boat: a small or medium watercraft with a visible hull, usually floating on water
descriptions.bottle: a portable container with a narrow neck, an opening, and a body wider than its neck
descriptions.bus: a large passenger road vehicle with a long body, multiple windows, and several wheels
descriptions.car: a four-wheeled passenger road vehicle with a roof, windows, and an enclosed body
descriptions.cat: a small feline with a rounded face, pointed ears, four legs, and a tail
descriptions.chair: a seat for one person with a seat surface, backrest, and supporting legs or frame
descriptions.cow: a large bovine with a broad body, four legs, hooves, and a muzzle
descriptions.diningtable: a table with a broad flat top and supporting legs, typically used for dining
descriptions.dog: a domesticated canine with a muzzle, four legs, paws, and a tail
descriptions.horse: a large four-legged equine with a long neck, mane, and tail
descriptions.motorbike: a motorized two-wheeled vehicle with a frame, seat, engine area, handlebars, and wheels
descriptions.person: a human figure with a head, torso, arms, legs, or another visible part of the body
descriptions.pottedplant: a living plant emerging from soil in a visible pot or plant container
descriptions.sheep: a woolly domesticated ruminant with a rounded body, four legs, and a short head
descriptions.sofa: an upholstered multi-seat couch with a long seat, backrest, and armrests
descriptions.train: a rail vehicle or connected set of rail cars with a long body and wheels, usually on tracks
descriptions.tvmonitor: a rectangular electronic display with a screen and surrounding bezel
descriptions.fish: an aquatic animal with a streamlined body, fins, scales, and a visible head or tail
descriptions.crazing: a network of fine, shallow, branching cracks forming a web-like pattern across a steel surface
descriptions.inclusion: an irregular non-metallic particle or foreign material embedded in or beneath the steel surface, often appearing as a contrasting spot or region
descriptions.patches: an irregular localized area of different brightness, color, texture, or oxidation on the steel surface
descriptions.pitted_surface: a steel surface marked by multiple small cavities or shallow round depressions, giving it a pitted texture
descriptions.rolled-in_scale: an elongated rough oxide scale or raised strip pressed into the steel surface during rolling
descriptions.scratches: thin elongated grooves or score marks running across the steel surface, usually straighter and narrower than crazing
descriptions.scallop: a fan-shaped bivalve shell with radiating ridges and a visible hinged or rounded edge, often resting on the seafloor
descriptions.seacucumber: an elongated soft-bodied marine animal with a cylindrical cucumber-like body and textured surface
descriptions.seaurchin: a rounded marine animal covered with many long, prominent spines
descriptions.Expressway-Service-area: a roadside service complex beside an expressway, with buildings, parking areas, and access roads
descriptions.Expressway-toll-station: a toll plaza spanning an expressway, with parallel traffic lanes, toll booths, or a canopy
descriptions.airplane: a fixed-wing aircraft seen from above, with a fuselage, wings, and tail
descriptions.airport: an extensive transport complex with runways, taxiways, terminals, aprons, or parked aircraft
descriptions.baseballfield: a baseball diamond with a dirt infield, grass outfield, bases, and surrounding foul territory
descriptions.basketballcourt: a rectangular court with painted boundary lines, a central division, and basketball hoops or key markings
descriptions.bridge: an elevated structure carrying a road or railway across water, a valley, or another route
descriptions.chimney: a tall narrow vertical stack rising from a building or industrial facility
descriptions.dam: a broad barrier crossing a river or valley, often adjoining a reservoir or spillway
descriptions.golffield: a golf-course area with fairways, greens, sand hazards, or distinctive mowed patterns
descriptions.groundtrackfield: an athletics complex with an oval running track surrounding a central field
descriptions.harbor: a sheltered waterfront with docks, piers, moored vessels, or enclosed water
descriptions.overpass: an elevated road or railway crossing above another road, railway, or ground-level route
descriptions.ship: a large water vessel with a hull, deck, and superstructure, usually visible on water
descriptions.stadium: a large sports arena with a central field or court surrounded by stands
descriptions.storagetank: a large industrial tank, commonly cylindrical with a flat or domed roof
descriptions.tenniscourt: a rectangular court with a central net and clearly marked playing lines
descriptions.trainstation: a railway facility with parallel tracks, platforms, station buildings, or a terminal
descriptions.vehicle: a road vehicle such as a car, truck, or bus, viewed from above and identified by its roof, body, or wheels
descriptions.windmill: a tall tower or structure topped by several long radial blades
